name: Import Wizard for Blogspot – Free Blogger to WordPress importer
author: Siteskyline Plugins

sections.description:
A comprehensive solution for Blogger to WordPress Migration

Do you want to switch from Blogger to WordPress without losing any of your content, images, or SEO settings? Import Wizard for Blogspot is a comprehensive WordPress plugin for blog migration that makes the process smooth and efficient.

Import Wizard for Blogspot allows you to transfer all your data from Blogger to WordPress in minutes. You don’t need any technical skills or coding knowledge – just paste your Blogger URL and let the plugin do the rest.

Why Choose Import Wizard for Blogspot

  • Simple Process – Just enter your Blogger URL and start importing
  • Preserves Your SEO – Maintain your search rankings during migration
  • Automatic Redirects – Seamless 301 redirects from Blogger to WordPress URLs
  • Content Integrity – Keep formatting, images, and layouts intact
  • Category Migration – Convert Blogger labels to WordPress categories
  • Featured Images – Automatically set the first image from your post as the featured image.

Features of this Migration Tool

  • Real-time Import Progress – See exactly what’s happening during import
  • Smart Error Handling – Helpful feedback if anything goes wrong
  • Free Version Includes – Import up to 20 posts and 20 pages with all features
  • Selective Import – Choose to import just posts, just pages, or both
  • No API Required – Direct import without complicated authentication

Demo Video

Upgrade to Pro Version for Unlimited Imports

Get the Pro Version Today!

The Pro version removes all limitations and adds powerful features to make your Blogger to WordPress migration even better:

  • Unlimited Posts & Pages – Import your entire Blogger site with no limits
  • Media Library Integration – Automatically download all images to your WordPress media library
  • Priority Support – Get direct help from our support team for any migration issues
  • Comment Import – Transfer all your blog comments with proper threading
  • Custom Fields Support – Preserve custom metadata during migration
  • Draft Import – Option to import posts as drafts for review before publishing
  • Bulk Redirects – Generate all necessary redirects with one click
  • Premium Updates – Get all future upgrades and new features

Suitable for Anyone Migrating from Blogger to WordPress

Whether you’re a blogger looking to upgrade your platform, a developer helping clients migrate, or a business moving to a more professional CMS, Import Wizard for Blogspot makes the transition smooth and worry-free.

Import Wizard for Blogspot helps you enjoy all the benefits of WordPress while keeping your content and SEO intact.

sections.faq:
How many Posts can I import with the free version?

The free version allows you to import up to 20 posts and 20 pages. For unlimited imports, check out our Pro version.

Will switching from Blogger to WordPress affect my SEO?

No, our plugin maintains your SEO by creating proper redirects from your old Blogger URLs to your new WordPress URLs, preserving your search engine rankings.

Do I need to provide API credentials for this Blogger to WordPress migration?

No! Unlike other importers, our Blogger to WordPress migration tool works without requiring any API setup or authentication.

How does the Blogger to WordPress import process work?

Simply enter your Blogger URL, select whether to import posts, pages, or both, and click “Start Import”. The plugin will fetch your content and import it into WordPress while showing you real-time progress.

Can I import pages from Blogger to WordPress?

Yes, you can import both posts and pages, or choose to import only posts or only pages.

How do I upgrade to the Pro version?

You can upgrade to the Pro version by visiting our website. After purchase, you’ll receive a download link and license key to activate all Pro features.

What are the advantages of the Pro version over the free version?

The Pro version allows unlimited imports (no 20 post/page limit), downloads images to your media library, imports comments, provides priority support, and includes several advanced features like custom field mapping and draft imports.
